COMPANY OVERVIEW

Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation.

Our mission is to “Earn The World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results.

We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Join us as a Senior Software Engineer building the next generation of AI products. This is a hands-on senior software development role: you'll spend roughly 80% of your time designing, building, and shipping full-stack product features and backend services, working with the latest AI, cloud, and developer technologies to deliver solutions used across the organization. The remaining ~20% is platform work — keeping the cloud environments, data pipelines, and deployment tooling behind our AI products reliable and secure.

Working closely with product and engineering, you will own features end to end — from technical design through release and iteration — while contributing to the CI/CD, infrastructure, and security practices that keep our AI platforms running well.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Software Engineering

• Build full-stack applications: Design, develop, and maintain Python & Node.js backend services and modern React frontends, delivering reliable APIs and intuitive user experiences.
• Own delivery end to end: Translate business requirements into technical solutions, leading features through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
• Develop integrations: Connect products with social media platforms, enterprise systems, external APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, handling authentication, data synchronization, and failures reliably.
• Shape technical architecture: Make thoughtful decisions about application structure, data models, performance, and scalability, balancing delivery needs with long-term maintainability.
• Raise engineering quality: Write clean, well-tested code, lead constructive code reviews, mentor developers, and improve engineering practices.
• Automation and Productivity: Use AI agents and tooling to build a robust, highly productive and fast paced engineering environment.
• Build for production: Embed security, monitoring, and observability into applications; troubleshoot issues and improve reliability and performance.
• Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product, design, and engineering to clarify requirements, identify risks, and deliver practical solutions.

Platform & DevOps

• Maintain efficient cloud infrastructure and development environments.
• Build and maintain data pipelines supporting AI products.
• Improve platform reliability, monitoring, logging, and performance.
• Ensure data quality, governance, and secure data handling.
• Implement secure deployment practices, CI/CD, and automated quality gates.
• Support dependency management, vulnerability remediation, and security testing.
• Ensure products follow secure coding standards and compliance requirements.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• High-quality product features delivered on schedule.
• Reliable data pipelines powering AI products.
• Highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure.
• Secure applications with vulnerabilities identified and remediated early.
• Strong collaboration across engineering, product, and security teams.
• Well-documented systems that are easy to maintain and scale.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• BSc or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 6+ years of professional software development experience, including backend and full-stack delivery.
• Working familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build), Docker, and cloud infrastructure management.
• Working knowledge of application security, including secure coding, IAM, OAuth/SSO, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and security best practices.
• Experience developing full-stack applications and APIs using modern technologies.
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to support production environments and improve application reliability.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, infrastructure, and security teams in an Agile environment.
• Experience with TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Node.js.
• Experience with untyped languages such as Python for backend development, along with relevant data management libraries.
• Familiarity with production application deployment and maintenance on AWS and/or Google Cloud.
• Familiarity with data orchestration and pipeline management.
• Experience with SQL and NoSQL based systems.
• Demonstrated experience owning and delivering projects end to end.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience integrating APIs, building automation workflows (e.g., n8n), and working with AI/LLM platforms such as Gemini, Vertex AI, OpenAI, or Claude.
• Familiarity with UX flows and writing specs/SOPs.
• Exposure to automation or agentic workflows.
• Hands-on experience with AI, LLM, and RAG-based systems.
• ‘Big Tech’ or large-scale product engineering experience.

PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

• Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns
• Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you—wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
• Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, top-tier learning access, and formal leadership development.
• Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
• Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
• Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

• Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always.
• Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.
• Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey.
• Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward.
• Seek Different Perspectives: Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact.

Scopely is looking for a
Product Marketing Manager
to join our
Star Trek™ Fleet Command
team, helping shape how one of mobile gaming's deepest, most enduring, and most community-driven live-service experiences is understood, experienced, and adopted by millions of players worldwide.
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Live Operations, Marketing, Community, Campaigns, and Player Experience. You will partner closely with Product teams to translate complex systems, features, and roadmap initiatives into compelling player value, ensuring every launch delivers a clear narrative, coordinated execution, and an exceptional player experience.
Product Marketing serves as the connective tissue across the player-facing organization. While Product defines what we build, Community builds trust, Campaign Marketing activates audiences, and Player Experience supports players, Product Marketing ensures every team is aligned around a shared strategy, consistent messaging, and a coordinated go-to-market plan.
Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You'll develop positioning, own go-to-market strategy, create messaging frameworks, build launch materials, guide creative development, and coordinate cross-functional teams to bring new features, seasonal content, technical improvements, and major Star Trek moments to life.
Star Trek Fleet Command is one of the most sophisticated strategy games in mobile. The ideal candidate enjoys simplifying complexity, thrives in cross-functional environments, and is energized by turning ambitious product ideas into experiences that players understand, value, and remember.
What You’ll Do:
Own the Player-Facing Narrative
Own the player-facing narrative for
Star Trek Fleet Command
, translating product strategy into clear, compelling experiences that help players understand not just
what
we're building, but
why
it matters
Champion the player perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring features, systems, and content are positioned in ways that resonate with our diverse player base
Establish messaging frameworks that create consistency across every player-facing touchpoint, from launch campaigns and CRM to roadmap communications and in-game messaging
Translate Product Strategy into Player Value
Partner with Product, Design, Economy, Live Operations, Analytics, and Creative teams throughout feature development
Translate complex gameplay systems, progression mechanics, monetization initiatives, technical improvements, and roadmap priorities into compelling player-facing narratives
Develop positioning, messaging, and value propositions for new features, seasonal content, technical improvements, and franchise initiatives
Ensure every major release tells a clear story that connects product innovation with meaningful player outcomes
Lead Go-to-Market Strategy
Own integrated go-to-market strategies for major game features, seasonal arcs, technical improvements, and franchise partnerships
Build launch plans that align messaging, timing, audiences, business objectives, and player education across every player-facing channel
Define player segmentation and messaging strategies that support players throughout their lifecycle and progression journey
Establish launch objectives and success criteria in partnership with Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams
Drive Cross-Functional Launch Readiness
Serve as the central marketing partner connecting Product, Community, Campaign Marketing, CRM, Creative, Analytics, Player Experience, Publishing, and external partners
Coordinate launch readiness across all player-facing functions, ensuring messaging, creative assets, support documentation, operational plans, and partner approvals are complete before release
Facilitate launch planning, milestone reviews, and cross-functional communication to proactively identify risks and remove blockers

Own Product Messaging & Creative Stewardship
Create creative briefs, messaging frameworks, presentations, launch documentation, executive materials, and marketing guidance that enable successful execution across the organization
Review and approve marketing assets to ensure consistency across channels and alignment with product strategy, brand standards, and franchise guidelines
Partner with Creative teams to develop high-quality marketing materials that communicate player value while maintaining franchise authenticity
Manage approvals and asset delivery with Paramount and other external partners
Measure Product Adoption & Optimize Performance
Monitor feature adoption, player engagement, sentiment, campaign performance, and commercial outcomes following launches
Partner with Analytics, Community, and Player Experience to identify player friction, adoption barriers, and opportunities for optimization
Translate quantitative and qualitative player insights into actionable recommendations for future launches and product improvements
Continuously refine positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies through experimentation, testing, and post-launch analysis
Lead the Product Marketing Function
Lead and evolve the Product Marketing discipline for Star Trek Fleet Command, continuously improving launch quality, planning processes, and organizational effectiveness
Manage the Campaign Manager, providing coaching, prioritization, and strategic direction across day-to-day marketing execution
Own the Product Marketing operating cadence, including roadmap reviews, launch planning, partner coordination, and cross-functional alignment
Build trusted relationships across Product, Marketing, Creative, Publishing, Licensing, and executive leadership to improve decision-making and execution
Establish scalable frameworks, documentation, and best practices that strengthen Product Marketing's impact across the organization
What We’re Looking For:
Who You Are
Strategic, curious, and relentlessly player-focused
Comfortable operating at the intersection of product strategy, marketing, and player experience
Motivated by turning complex systems into simple, compelling stories that players understand and value
Collaborative by nature, bringing diverse teams together around a shared vision and common goals
Equally confident leading strategic discussions with executives and producing hands-on deliverables that move launches forward
Data-informed but never data-limited, combining analytics with player empathy to make sound decisions
Adaptable in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve and every launch presents new opportunities to learn
Passionate about live-service games and excited by the challenge of helping millions of players discover, understand, and engage with new experiences
What You've Done
Translated complex products into compelling player stories, developing positioning and go-to-market strategies that improved player understanding, feature adoption, engagement, and commercial performance
Led integrated product launches, bringing together Product, Creative, Community, Lifecycle Marketing, Analytics, Campaigns, and external partners around a unified player experience
Influenced product direction through player insights, leveraging qualitative feedback, quantitative data, and market trends to shape messaging, prioritization, and launch strategy
Built scalable marketing frameworks, creating repeatable processes, messaging systems, and launch playbooks that improved organizational effectiveness and cross-functional collaboration
Partnered with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-impact initiatives in fast-paced, live-service environments where priorities evolve quickly and execution matters
Mentored marketers and fostered collaborative, high-performing teams while maintaining a hands-on approach to strategy and execution
Have 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, Integrated Marketing, or related roles within games, entertainment, technology, or digital products
Bonus
Experience working on live-service or free-to-play games
Familiarity with player lifecycle marketing, CRM, audience segmentation, and experimentation
Experience partnering with analytics teams to evaluate player behavior, feature adoption, and commercial performance
Experience working with licensed entertainment brands or franchise partners
Familiarity with creative production pipelines and integrated campaign development
Passion for strategy games, mobile games, or live-service products
Knowledge of Star Trek™ and an appreciation for its characters, stories, and passionate global community
About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

•

•

Lead initial data assessments, evaluating quality, compliance, privacy practices, and overall strategic fit for Nasdaq's data products portfolio.

•

Negotiate and initiate complex data licensing agreements, revenue-share models, and strategic alliances that protect partner intellectual property while maximizing mutual value.
